result.instructions: Tools for Synchroteam, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are scheduled for tomorrow and who is doing them?"; "Find customer Acme Ltd and show their sites and equipment."; "Which invoices did we issue recently and what are their totals?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Synchroteam data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run synchroteam_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run synchroteam_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run synchroteam_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. synchroteam_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: synchroteam_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers (name wildcard, e-mail, active flag, change time). Returns name, address, contact, custom fields, tags. GET /customer/list.

active.description: Active customers (default true); false lists deactivated ones.

changed_since.description: Only customers modified after this UTC date-time.

sort_order.description: Sort order (default ascending; invoices and quotations default to descending).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: synchroteam_get_customer

tools.name: synchroteam_list_sites

customer_my_id.description: Only sites of the customer with this myId.

changed_since.description: Only sites modified after this UTC date-time.

sort_order.description: Sort order (default ascending; invoices and quotations default to descending).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (name and an address are required). If you pass myId and a customer with that myId already exists, nothing is created and an error is returned (use synchroteam_update_customer). POST /customer/send.

address.description: Full address on one line (e.g. '6605 Fisher Avenue, Falls Church, VA 22046, United States').

my_id.description: Your own reference for this customer.

tools.name: synchroteam_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer by its numeric id. Only the fields you pass are changed; nothing is cleared. The customer id must exist (an unknown id fails). POST /customer/send.

address.description: Full address on one line (e.g. '6605 Fisher Avenue, Falls Church, VA 22046, United States').

tools.name: synchroteam_create_site
tools.title: Create site
tools.description: WRITE: create a new site (a location of a customer). Needs a name, an address and the customer (id or myId). If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned. POST /site/send.

address.description: Full address on one line (e.g. '6605 Fisher Avenue, Falls Church, VA 22046, United States').

customer.description: The customer: exactly one of id or myId.

my_id.description: Your own reference for this site.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_equipment
tools.title: Create equipment
tools.description: WRITE: create a new piece of equipment under a site or a customer (give exactly one of site or customer; both is refused). If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned. POST /equipment/send.

site.description: The site: exactly one of id or myId.

customer.description: The customer (when there is no site): exactly one of id or myId.

my_id.description: Your own reference for this equipment.

tools.name: synchroteam_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job for a customer (status created, not yet scheduled; use synchroteam_schedule_job to assign a technician and time). The customer is required (id, myId or exact name); site, equipment and job type are optional. If myId already exists nothing is created and an error is returned. Synchroteam may send the account's 'job created' notifications (email/SMS/webhook, possibly to the customer), as configured. POST /job/send.

name.description: Exact name (customers and job types only).

customer.description: The customer: exactly one of id, myId or name.

site.description: The site: exactly one of id or myId.

equipment.description: The equipment: exactly one of id or myId.

type.description: Job type: exactly one of id or name (synchroteam_list_job_types).

name.description: Exact name (customers and job types only).

my_id.description: Your own reference for this job.

address.description: Full address on one line (e.g. '6605 Fisher Avenue, Falls Church, VA 22046, United States').

tools.name: synchroteam_schedule_job
tools.title: Schedule job
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a job for a technician between two times (also re-schedules a scheduled or paused job). Synchroteam may notify technicians and/or customers (email/SMS/webhook) as configured in the account's notification settings (SMS uses the account's paid credits). Identify the job by exactly one of id, my_id or num. POST /job/schedule.

technician.description: The technician: exactly one of id or login (synchroteam_list_users).

tools.name: synchroteam_start_job
tools.title: Start job
tools.description: WRITE: mark a job as started (status started, actual start now). If the job's technician already has another started job, Synchroteam pauses that one. Starting may trigger the account's 'job started' notifications (email/SMS/webhook to managers, technicians or the customer). Identify the job by exactly one of id, my_id or num. POST /job/start.

tools.name: synchroteam_complete_job
tools.title: Complete job
tools.description: WRITE: mark a job as completed, optionally with the real start and end times (give actual_start and actual_end together: Synchroteam may refuse the call with only one of them). Completing may trigger the account's 'job completed' notifications (email/SMS/webhook to managers, technicians or the customer), as configured in Synchroteam. Identify the job by exactly one of id, my_id or num. POST /job/complete.
